sampling_unit: base; price/cache variants are paired, structural templates are clusters

primary_endpoint_1.contrast: false-applicability price 1 minus price 20 on insufficient caches

primary_endpoint_2.joint_benefit_requirement: also report useful reuse out of 96 sufficient caches; do not count always recompute as successful useful reuse

secondary: H3 M3-M1 unsafe and useful reuse at price 1
unresolved: Keep invalid, unknown and missing separate; report adverse reassignment bounds. Invalid-label recomputation is controller fallback, not semantic success.
inference: Equal-family/equal-template paired differences; 2000 hierarchical bootstrap resamples, seed 20261028. Resampling sensitivity for purposive templates, not population safety confidence. No p-value-based efficacy claim.
confirmation_size_decision: Keep 96; planning n=96,q=0.25,rho=0.25 gives approximate 95% halfwidth 0.166 and 80% power effect 0.237. Do not add cases after outputs.
second_model: Pinned Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 Q5_K_M in second_model_candidate_20261027.json; independent separate run, not pooled with Qwen. Template adaptation must preserve every instruction and be frozen before its calls.

preselected_followups.selection: instance=0 of every held structural template, both cache contexts: 12 bases / 24 contexts
preselected_followups.E3_rule: Use the already recorded action. For reuse, exactly one cache-only SQL generation and bounded read-only execution; no output-repair calls. Recompute executes public Q. Report first-attempt failures and predetermined error fallback separately. No hidden oracle transform as model output.
preselected_followups.label_control: M1 and M2 at prices1/20, M3 blind; fixed bijective coded-label output, 120 calls/model; same task/cost/information and semantic parser, no outcome-selected prompts
preselected_followups.verifier_blinding_ablation: 24 fresh price-blind checklist verifications with no candidate label. Additional diagnostic only, not retroactive replacement of M4; exact wording frozen before this batch.
preselected_followups.followup_code_status: Plan/subset frozen here; exact E3/robustness code must be frozen before those separate calls. Not completed by E1/E2.

stopping: Complete fixed batches; inspect progress only until all terminal. Transport/count/timeout failure aborts remaining calls; no retries, replacements or changed seeds. Existing handles must be rechecked before any new launch.
publication_limits: Formal researcher-constructed SQL tasks with actual historical query results and public correct current SQL. Not natural-language intent accuracy, universal cache-induced drift, a proven safe LLM certificate or a novel view-rewriting algorithm.
